compiler.name: lanius
compiler.version:
laniusc 0.1.0
language-edition: unstable-alpha
edition-policy: no stable production language edition yet; accepts the current alpha slice only
targets: x86_64, wasm
default-target: x86_64
target-triples: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, wasm32-unknown-unknown
x86_64: bounded HIR main-return, same-module resolver-backed scalar constants, and direct scalar helper-call source-pack slices; unsupported source shapes are reported as unsupported-feature diagnostics
formatter: unstable-alpha lexical full-document formatter
release-channel: source-worktree
distribution-status: not-production-release; no stable install artifact or package manager channel
lsp-capabilities-schema-name: laniusc.lsp.capabilities
lsp-capabilities-schema: 15
lsp-experimental-schema-name: laniusc.lsp.experimental
lsp-experimental-schema: 13
lsp-error-data-schema-name: laniusc.lsp.error-data
lsp-error-data-schema: 2
slangc: 2026.2
wgpu: 29.0.3
build-profile: release
shader-artifact-digest: f04a44693ccd0cd1
shader-artifact-count: 586
shader-artifact-max-bytes: 523640
shader-artifact-max-name: codegen/lir/x86/emit
shader-artifact-size-guard: enforced
shader-artifact-max-spv-bytes: 524288
slangc-version-timeout-ms: 2000
shader-compile-timeout-ms: 120000
